hero.titulo1: What Spanish law requires of you and your pet,
hero.entradilla: Insurance, microchip, course, dangerous dog licence, census… We tell you what can really be enforced in your municipality and what cannot, with the article and the official link behind every answer.

contraste.titulo: What you usually read, compared with what the law says
contraste.texto: Act 7/2023 is in force, but part of it depends on regulations that have not been published, and each region has its own law. That is why so much contradictory information goes around.
contraste.p1a: Since 2023 insurance is mandatory for every dog.
contraste.p1b: Act 7/2023 requires it, but leaves the amount to an unpublished regulation: at national level it cannot be enforced yet.
contraste.p2a: You already have to take the course to own a dog.
contraste.p2b: The course is mandatory on paper, but its content depends on a regulation that does not exist: it cannot be taken yet.
contraste.p3a: The new law did away with the dangerous dogs rules.
contraste.p3b: Act 50/1999 and Royal Decree 287/2002 are still in force: local licence and insurance of at least €120,000.
contraste.p4a: The same rules apply all over Spain.
contraste.p4b: Each region has its own law: in the Basque Country dog insurance is already mandatory; in Madrid it depends on a regulation.

estado.titulo: What can be enforced today all over Spain
estado.texto: This is what national law says for anyone with a dog or a cat. Your region and your town council may add more.

pasos.titulo: Three questions and an answer you can check
pasos.texto: No sign-up and no personal data. The result is calculated by a rules engine that always applies the same criteria.
pasos.p1t: Dog, cat, ferret or another species. Each one has different obligations.
pasos.p2t: We search the 8,132 municipalities listed by the INE, tolerating accents and typos.
pasos.p3: Your list, with the laws behind it
pasos.p3t: What can be enforced, what is pending and what we do not know yet, with the literal quote of each law.

guias.titulo: Everything the law can require of you, by topic
guias.texto: Each guide explains the obligation, what can be enforced today and how it changes from one region to another.
guias.queHacerTexto: You have lost your animal, you find an abandoned one, there is a bite or you witness animal abuse.
guias.multasTexto: The literal ranges set by law for each type of offence, with no made-up amounts.
guias.pppTexto: Choose the breed and the region: we tell you whether it counts as potentially dangerous and what that involves.
guias.segurosTexto: What cover each area requires and what to ask your insurer.

confianza.texto: We never say something is mandatory if it is not yet, and we always separate what the law says from what can be enforced today.
confianza.f1t: The text of the law as it is, taken from the BOE, with a link to the exact article.
confianza.f2t: Each quote says when we last checked it.
confianza.f3: If we don't know, we say so
confianza.f3t: "Not verified yet" does not mean "does not affect you". It means "we don't know yet".
confianza.f4t: We don't sell insurance or take commissions. No ads and no analytics.
